description:
From the manufacturer  




 X200 Pro RPD  


 
 India's 1st 200MP ZEISS APO Telephoto Camera*   The X200 Pro's 1/1.4-inch sensor and floating periscope system bring distant details to life. Thanks to ZEISS APO color correction certification, you can experience sharp images with true-to-life colors, even at extreme zoom.  


 
 200MP ZEISS APO Telephoto Camera   Telephoto Hyperzoom: Get closer than ever, without compromising quality.   Telephoto Macro : Reveal the beauty in every fine detail.   Telephoto Portrait : Capture stunning, life-like detail with the all-new 135mm portrait focal length   Telephoto Nightscape : Illuminate the night with vivid clarity.  


 
 Industry's 1st Super Landscape Mode*   An industry-first, Landscape Mode blends nightscape, moonlight, starlight, and long exposure into one   -capturing breathtaking shots with a single tap.  









 
 ZEISS Multifocal Portrait   Unleash creativity across all focal lengths. With 23 mm to 135 mm options, vivo X200 Pro gives you the versatility to capture perfect portraits from any distance.  


 
 Street Photography Mode   Street Photography Mode brings out the art in every scene, combining Textured Color with classic Black-and-White and other styles.  


 
 4K HDR Cinematic Portrait Video   Capture breathtaking backlit portraits video in stunning high definition. No matter the light, your subjects will always look their best.  









 
 4K 60 fps HDR Dolby Vision shooting   Experience professional-grade 4K HDR at 60fps across every focal length, with Dolby Vision quality from recording to playback.  


 
 Dual Flagship Chip (Dimensity 9400 & V3+)   Powered by 3nm Dimensity 9400 with next-gen CPU architecture, vivo X200 Pro delivers powerful performance with efficient cooling, ensuring smooth operation without overheating or battery drain.   The V3+chip in vivo X200 Pro enhances computational imaging with superior power efficiency, delivering unmatched clarity and vibrance in both photography and video.  


 
 India's 1st 6000 mAh Semi-Solid State Battery   vivo X200 Pro's 6000 mAhbattery, powered by 3rd-Gen Silicon Anode and Semi-Solid Battery Technology, ensures enduring performance even in extreme cold down to -20°C. Plus, with 90W   Flash Charge, you're powered up and ready to go in no time.  









 
 ZEISS Master Color Display   Enhanced with ZEISS Natural Color and LTPO technology, the ZEISS: Master Color Display brings visuals to life, as real as the world around you.  


 
 IP68 &IP69 Ratings *   With IP68 & IP69 water and dust resistance, vivo X200 Pro stands strong against the elements, delivering peace of mind in any weather.*  


 
 Xtreme Design   Sleek and bold. vivo X200 Pro's Equal-Depth Quad Curved Display offers an immersive experience with a uniform curve, reinforced by Armor Glass for enhanced durability.  









 
 AI Photo Enhance   AI Photo Enhance : Enhance image clarity with ultra-clear technology that makes every detail pop.  


 
 AI Erase   AI Erase : Erase unwanted elements and perfect your images with ease for flawless photos.  


 
 Funtouch OS 15   Vivo Live Call Translation – Overcome language barriers with real-time, two-way translation for more accurate, efficient calls and seamless communication..   Circle to Search – Just circle, highlight, or doodle on an image to initiate searching , providing an all-new mobile search method.   Gemini Assistant – vivo X200 comes with Gemini Assistant. Get help learning in new ways, writing emails, planning events and more.
